details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced a significant surge in inflows, recording eight consecutive days of positive inflows through April 23, amounting to $2.43 billion in April alone. BlackRock's IBIT has been a primary driver, absorbing over $3 billion year-to-date and now holding more than 800,000 BTC. These sustained institutional inflows suggest strong accumulation and indicate that the total cumulative inflows for Bitcoin ETFs are approaching their lifetime peak.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Strong Inflows, Nearing All-Time Highs

details: Bitcoin is currently consolidating within the $77,000-$80,000 range, with market sentiment influenced by ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly regarding US-Iran relations, which have led to some volatility and dampened risk appetite. Despite these pressures, institutional demand continues to provide support, with analysts identifying the $70,000-$75,000 range as a key accumulation zone. While some short-term divergences exist between bullish and bearish positions, and recent rallies have been partly attributed to short squeezes, Bitcoin's ability to hold above critical levels is seen as a significant market signal.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Around $78K Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: The Ethereum Foundation has completed an over-the-counter (OTC) sale of 10,000 ETH to BitMNR (Tom Lee's Bitmine Immersion Technologies) for approximately $23.87 million, at an average price of $2,387 per token. The Foundation stated that the proceeds are intended to fund core operations, including protocol research, ecosystem development, and community grants. This transaction has generated discussion within the community, with some critics questioning the Foundation's repeated sales of ETH. Bitmine, a prominent institutional accumulator, is known for its aggressive ETH treasury strategy.
title: Ethereum Foundation Sells 10,000 ETH, Sparks Community Debate

details: Ethereum has demonstrated robust network activity, generating approximately $2.7 million in daily network fees, significantly outperforming Solana by nearly 40 times. This highlights Ethereum's strong adoption for high-value transactions and DeFi activity. Concurrently, bullish sentiment is building in Ethereum derivatives markets, with a notable concentration of open interest in call options around the $3,200 strike price. Additionally, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded their longest inflow streak this year, indicating renewed investor confidence.
title: Ethereum Outpaces Solana in Fees; Bullish Bets on ETH Rise

details: The altcoin market is experiencing a challenging April, marked by over $630 million in losses from DeFi hacks, which has exacerbated a broader sell-off and accelerated liquidity outflows. This decline has pushed the DeFi market index lower, leading to widespread weakness across altcoins. While Bitcoin has shown relative resilience, the mounting downside pressure on altcoins, coupled with macro uncertainty, is expected to limit the overall upside potential for the cryptocurrency market. The "Kelp incident" is cited as a significant contributor to the recent losses.
title: Altcoins Suffer 'Worst April' Amid $630M DeFi Hack Losses

details: Canary Capital has submitted an application for the first-ever TRON (TRX) spot ETF, which includes built-in staking rewards. This move is seen as a significant institutional validation for TRON, placing it within the same regulatory discourse as Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs. This development underscores TRON's increasing credibility, particularly given its established role as a premier stablecoin settlement layer, and suggests expanding institutional interest beyond the two largest cryptocurrencies.
title: TRON (TRX) Spot ETF Filing Signals Growing Institutional Interest
